The Studio

Not a salon visit — a standing appointment with yourself.

Munoz Barbershop and Hairsalon built its name in Santa Ana on one belief: a great cut is never rushed. Every appointment starts with a real consultation and ends with you knowing exactly how to keep the look alive at home.

  • Senior barbers only — no hand-offs, no surprises
  • Honest timelines & honest pricing, up front
  • Sharp fades and clean lines, every time

— Good to know

Before you book.

Every service lists its duration and price up front — and if it's not right, we make it right. That's our guarantee.

How much will it cost?

Prices are confirmed at your consultation, before any work begins. The final price is confirmed before any work begins, so the price you approve is the price you pay.

How long will my appointment take?

A cut takes 30–60 minutes. Every service lists its duration, and your barber confirms it at booking — no rushing, no surprises.

What if I don't like the result?

If it's not right, we make it right — re-cut or adjust, no charge. That's our guarantee.

What to expect at your first visit

A real consultation first: your barber looks at your hair, asks how you wear it, and agrees the cut with you before starting. You leave knowing exactly how to keep the look alive at home.

10% off your first visit

New clients save 10% on their first appointment — mention this page when you book.
